per_candidate.id: s2:Amplification of superkicks in black-hole binaries through orbital eccentricity, 2020-01-22

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the relationship between the projected spins of progenitor black holes in binary mergers and the formation mechanisms of supermassive black holes in galaxies. They focus on related topics such as primordial black holes and gravitational wave detections.
